verdict.rationale: RustDesk describes itself as an AGPL-licensed remote desktop client and OSS server. The GitHub repo documents cloning and building the source and describes code modules such as libs/clipboard. A community member who commented on the code itself independently confirms the source can be read. missing for 10: the commercial Server Pro tier is not shown to be open source, and the evidence does not quote the repository's license file directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: RustDesk provides an AGPL-licensed remote desktop client and OSS server
Server OSS: a free, open-source ID/rendezvous server (hbbs) and relay server (hbbr) that you can deploy on your own infrastructure.
Begin by cloning the repository and building the Docker container
libs/clipboard: file copy and paste implementation for Windows, Linux, macOS.
